added_lines: today, the church rejoices as we celebrate the solemnity of all saints. we honour the countless men and women who now share in the glory of heaven. the saints are living witnesses to the saving grace of our god. today, we are reminded that the saints inspire and urge us to seek their company in the heavenly kingdom. through their example, they show us that holiness is possible at every age and in all circumstances. therefore, we are called to strive towards the blessedness that god has promised to all of us who love him faithfully. this day reminds us that holiness is not reserved for a few extraordinary individuals; instead, it is a possibility for every soul called to live a life reflecting christ’s love. the feast invites us to meditate on the virtues of the saints and to seek their intercession, strengthening our own journey towards spiritual perfection. the church sees this day as an affirmation of the communion of saints, a mystical bond that unites all believers across time and space. in celebrating this feast, we remember that our lives are intertwined with the legacy of faith, grace, and moral courage instilled by those who have gone before us. steps to obtain a plenary indulgence for souls in purgatory – november 1 - gospel reflection (matthew 22:34-40) in todayʼs gospel, jesus teaches that the greatest commandm ent is to love god wholeheartedly and to love our neighbour as ourselves. these two responsibilities are inseparable and form the foundation of christian life. loving god involves more than religious practices such as pr ayer, worship, and scripture reading. it means trusting him in di�icult times, remaining faithful through challenges, choosing what is right, and allowing to guide every aspect of our lives. genuine love for god is shown not only in words also in daily actions. our love for god becomes visible in how we treat others. we can not truly love god while harming, judging, or refusing to forgive those around us. instead, we are called to show compassion, kindness, patience, and mercy. even simple acts such as listening, encouraging, forgiving, and helping those in need can become powerful expressions of godʼs love. jesus also calls us to recognize the dignity and worth of every person, including those who di�er from us or disappoint us. true love does not ig nore wrongdoing, but it speaks the truth with respect and sets boundaries with out hatred. clonleigh (strabane pastoral area)
